summary: Crow's nest recorded at Wapaloosie Mountain in Ferry County, WA in 1920 and abandoned in the 1920s; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1920s; no source we read says what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: First record: a crow's nest at the site; no build date given
Abandoned in the 1920s; the sources give no exact year

evidence.supports: crow's nest at the site in 1920; abandoned in the 1920s
evidence.quote: In 1920, a crows nest was at the site. It was abandoned in the 1920s.

evidence.supports: trail passing just below the summit today was built in the 1920s or earlier
evidence.quote: The same trail today that passed just below the summit was built in the 1920s or prior.

evidence.supports: listed as Crowsnest type, Abandoned status
Forest Service photo labeled Wapaloosie Mountain Lookout, lookout in front of a tent shelter
evidence.quote: Wapaloosie Mountain Lookout; Lookout standing in front of tent shelter

corrections.why: The sources say the crow's nest was abandoned in the 1920s. None of the pages we read says it was removed or destroyed.

notes_for_editor: The record's status 'gone' is not supported by any page read. They say the crow's nest was abandoned in the 1920s and do not say it was removed or destroyed, so confirm before changing it. Record coordinates match firelookout.org's list. A USFS photo labeled Wapaloosie Mountain Lookout sits in the Crossroads Archive collection (public domain), but its image URL was not found, so no photo is added. No staffing, fire or access information in any source read. Four short pages, so the record is thin.
